dogecoin.text:
#dogecoin is now in the top 5 of all cryptocurrencies.  

If people believe it has value then it has value. Simple. 

Ask the seller of the $60m NFT artwork or the person who paid $2m for Kanye West’s second hand trainers. 

We’re not in Kansas anymore...

#DogecoinToTheMoon

And people think crypto and #dogecoin is odd...

I’m often asked “why would anyone invest in something that has no underlying value?”

Meanwhile 24,000 (!) people just voted for a man dressed as a bin to be Mayor of one of the biggest financial centres in the world.
#LondonMayor

So @elonmusk wasn’t joking after all - #dogecoin is literally going to the moon. 

The company SpaceX are being paid in Dogecoin for launching their lunar payload. 

Never a dull moment.

#doge #dogetothemoon

COVID has deprived me of a trip to Bucharest but at least I still get to talk about my two favourite things - seized assets and #cryptocurrencies 

(And undoubtedly #dogecoin will be on the agenda!)

Hope you can join us for this free live event on Facebook
